purpose: Bounded target-conditioned retrieval of natural passages for an exploratory English VPC/VID material pilot
supersedes: The stopped target-blind 24-article VOA frame; it does not alter or reopen that frame

source_frame.audience_rationale: The official About page identifies people learning English among the intended audiences; this does not make every article an L2-validated reading passage.
source_frame.acquisition_rule: Download only this dated artifact into ignored local research_data; verify byte size and SHA-1 before decompression or article inspection.

page_frame.revision: current revision contained in the dated dump

passage_unit.rule: All rendered main-body prose paragraphs in document order, with section headings retained
passage_unit.coherence_rule: Reject the article if the mechanical exclusions break propositional coherence; do not repair it by selecting or rewriting sentences.
passage_unit.no_target_editing: Do not insert, replace, delete, reorder, bold, gloss, or otherwise manipulate a target occurrence during Gate 1.

rights.working_license_route: Applicable Wikimedia text terms, expected CC BY-SA 4.0/GFDL; verify the selected page and imported-text notices individually before release
required_record: revision ID and permanent revision URL
license and any additional attribution notice
retrieval date and exact extracted-text SHA-256
rights.release_boundary: The dump and media stay outside Git. Selected text is not publicly packaged until every page-level attribution and ShareAlike requirement is complete.

pool_rule.component_rule: Every canonical member has an NGSL 1.2 head at rank 2000 or earlier.
pool_rule.low_risk_pilot_rule: Before source retrieval, exclude a type whose conventional meaning necessarily centers death, self-harm, sexual violence, or acute violence.
pool_rule.ranking: Within VPC and VID separately: descending OEWN sense count, then descending STREUSLE train count, then ASCII canonical form.
pool_rule.selection: First four VPC types and first two VID types after the frozen filters.

prespecified_exclusions.evidence: STREUSLE train V.VID x3; OEWN senses x2; NGSL member ranks 416 and 234
prespecified_exclusions.reason: Excluded before passage retrieval by the low-risk first-pilot rule because its conventional meaning necessarily centers death.

prespecified_exclusions.evidence: OEWN projects take part with one sense and no exact take part in entry; no exact take part or take part in type occurs in the pinned STREUSLE train split.
prespecified_exclusions.reason: Retained as a future unit-boundary/adposition stress case, not added as an exception that would silently widen the frozen VPC/VID target pool.

candidate_generation.role: High-recall lead generation only; no match is occurrence, idiomaticity, category, or sense truth.
candidate_generation.surface_forms: Use the pinned NGSL surface-to-head projection for verb inflections; require the non-verbal canonical member exactly.
candidate_generation.vpc_pattern: Allow contiguous members or 1-8 intervening profile tokens, preserving every gap token for review; this includes pronoun/NP cases such as take it in.
candidate_generation.vid_pattern: Require adjacent inflected verb plus exact it for make it and get it.
candidate_generation.deduplication: One candidate page per target form and page ID, regardless of occurrence count.
candidate_generation.manual_review: Review the complete retained article for false spans, missed target occurrences, category, members/gaps, idiomaticity, operational paraphrase meaning, OEWN candidates, source cueing, and centrality.

passage_constraints.length_role: Pragmatic development bracket, not a coverage or comprehension threshold; revise only in a new design version.
passage_constraints.target_location: A usable focal occurrence is in ordinary main prose, not the title, heading, quotation-only material, caption, list, table, reference, bold/italic teaching cue, explicit gloss, or target-level hyperlink.
passage_constraints.background: The global proposition must be answerable from the retained prose without specialist formulas, tabular lookup, or assumed knowledge of a named person/event/institution.
passage_constraints.content: Exclude self-harm, sexual violence, graphic or acute violence, and individualized medical/legal/financial advice from the low-risk first pilot.
passage_constraints.centrality: The focal meaning must be needed for at least one proposition contributing to an uncued global-comprehension item; a phrase-definition item cannot establish centrality.
passage_constraints.word_profiles: Compute NGSL and local BNC/COCA profiles after selection as continuous descriptors. Do not select passages for being near 95% or 98%.

sampling.queue_key: SHA-256 of gate1-simplewiki-route2-v1, newline, canonical form, newline, page ID, newline, revision ID; ascending hexadecimal order
sampling.screening_rule: For each target, review the first 20 mechanically eligible pages or stop earlier when three admissible pages spanning at least two operational paraphrase meanings are available.
sampling.sense_stratified_selection: Select the earliest admissible page, the earliest admissible page with a clearly different operational paraphrase meaning, and then the earliest remaining admissible page.
sampling.article_assignment: A page may serve only one focal target. Assign a cross-target page to the higher-priority target and log every non-focal target occurrence.
sampling.retention: Retain every queue row, automated exclusion, desk decision, provisional sense decision, and admissible-but-unselected row without article prose in the public sampling ledger.

gate.per_target: Exactly three distinct articles and at least two clearly different provisional operational paraphrase meanings.
gate.minimum_panel: At least four successful target types, including at least three VPC types and at least one VID type.
gate.discontinuity: At least one admitted VPC occurrence must contain a naturally intervening pronoun or noun-phrase object; otherwise the discontinuous-VPC material claim fails.
stop_rules: Stop before inspection if artifact size or SHA-1 does not match.
Stop a target after 20 desk screens; do not extend its queue in this design version.
After all six target queues, stop Route 2 if the minimum panel or discontinuity condition fails; do not add a source, target, excerpt, or relaxed rule post hoc.
No passage is admitted until exact rights, prose-boundary, MWE, sense, centrality, and question records are complete.

permitted: Feasibility of constructing a bounded target-conditioned natural-passage VPC/VID material panel
Transparent comparison of conventional word-profile output with separately reviewed focal MWE occurrences in those selected passages
forbidden: MWE prevalence in Simple English Wikipedia or general English
Representative lexical coverage of L2 reading
Learner knowledge or comprehension before participant measures
Automatic occurrence, idiomaticity, category, or contextual-sense accuracy

implementation_boundary: This freeze authorizes only local dump verification and an offline sampling ledger. It does not admit text, expand the Web app's sense inventory, add BERT, or begin human annotation.
